about: A level-cap step, in a wild battle: no milestone yet: the cap is 10 (GetLevelCap). A level-9 Snorlax, one point short of its next level, leads against a forced wild Geodude and switches out for a level-10 Tauros at the cap, also one point short, which knocks the Geodude out with Guillotine (taught in the battle, its accuracy roll forced). Both took part: Snorlax, under the cap, gains and grows to 10; Tauros, at the cap, gains nothing and no line says it did. The battle has to end (gDiagBattleState 15, EXIT). The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
